prompt:
Use case: seasonal edit of an existing painting.
Asset type: a precisely composition-matched Halloween-night state of an existing ambient video-game scene. It will be slowly composited directly over the original painting, so geometric registration is critical.
Input image: the supplied neon-rain-night.png is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose reference. Original canvas is 1672 by 941 pixels, approximately 16:9 landscape. Keep the same full image framing, aspect ratio, view, perspective, object scale and positions.
Preserve the original illustration, composition and every landmark contour as closely as possible: the open-front tea shelter on the left with its tiled roof, magenta neon trim, glowing windows, hanging paper lantern, the wooden chair with the sleeping dark cat, the large pot, the stone steps, the whole reflecting pond and its stone rim, the city skyline, signs, wires, towers and distant windows, the stone lanterns and ferns at the edges. Do not redraw or reinterpret their shapes.
Add, painted in exactly the same hand-painted style, brushwork and palette so they look like they were always part of it:
- Five carved jack-o'-lanterns resting naturally: one on the shelter's wooden floor beside the chair, two together on the stone steps below the shelter, one on the pond's stone rim at centre, and one beside the stone lantern at right. Sizes matched to depth. Gentle, friendly carvings (simple smiling faces, one with a crescent moon), lit from within by warm candlelight, casting amber light on the wet stone and small warm reflections in the pond, with believable contact shadows.
- A soft, pale-gold harvest moon glowing through a gap in the clouds above the city at upper centre, partly veiled by thin cloud, with a faint shimmer in the pond.
- Three or four very small bat silhouettes against the clouds near the moon.
- A short string of small round orange paper lanterns along the front edge of the shelter's eaves, and a few red-orange maple leaves among the potted plants and on the steps.
Lighting and palette: keep the existing evening palette and mood; the jack-o'-lanterns join the existing warm lights. Cosy and inviting, not scary.
Strict constraints: identical camera and composition; do not crop, zoom or move edges; do not change water geometry, silhouettes or existing objects; no skulls, ghosts, witches, cobwebs, gravestones, characters, text, legible signs, graphics, watermark or UI. Paint no rain streaks, falling snow or floating particles (those animate in code). Preserve fine spatial detail and edges. Deliver one complete landscape image at the same size.
assessment: A 50/50 blend with its source shows no doubled edges on landmarks, shorelines or water; only the added Halloween objects differ.
